description: Deterministic prompt corpus for Wonder scene benchmark reports.

prompts.title: Alchemist Observatory
prompts.prompt: A single-room alchemist observatory with an astrolabe table, moon window, archive door, ritual candles, brass instruments, readable work zones, and two curiosity hooks.
style_variations: sacred brass and deep blue glass

patch_operations.instruction: Make the observatory feel more sacred while preserving object IDs and layout.
Make the archive door read as the next interaction target.
Increase focus on the astrolabe table without moving cameras.

prompts.title: Mountain Lightning City
prompts.prompt: A cliffside mountain city powered by captured lightning, with tiered roofs, storm rods, cable bridges, glowing transformer shrines, safe walkable paths, and a reveal camera from below.

patch_operations.instruction: Strengthen the stepped skyline and lightning rod silhouette.
Clarify the main path and railings without changing city scale.
Make the captured lightning source the visual focal point.

prompts.title: Abandoned Roblox Mall
prompts.prompt: An abandoned Roblox-scale mall atrium with shuttered shops, blocky signage, escalator ruins, coin machines, low-poly debris, mobile-friendly geometry, and a mystery behind one storefront.

patch_operations.instruction: Improve playable path clarity for a Roblox mobile user.
Replace risky signage with fictional mall brands.
Make the hidden storefront hook clearer while preserving layout.

prompts.title: Underwater Train Station
prompts.prompt: An underwater train station sealed inside glass tubes, with a stopped train, ticket booth, kelp shadows, pressure doors, bubbles, emergency lights, and a route to a flooded platform.

patch_operations.instruction: Increase the sense of underwater depth without obscuring objects.
Make the path to the flooded platform more legible.
Improve focal lighting on the stopped train.

prompts.title: Desert Oracle Shrine
prompts.prompt: A desert oracle shrine half-buried in sand, with carved pillars, sun disks, offering bowls, wind cloth, cracked tile paths, a sealed prophecy chamber, and warm horizon lighting.

patch_operations.instruction: Simplify prop clutter while keeping the shrine readable.
Make the sealed prophecy chamber a stronger curiosity hook.
Shift lighting toward warm sunset without losing contrast.

prompts.title: Cozy Witch Greenhouse
prompts.prompt: A cozy witch greenhouse with hanging herbs, potion benches, moonlit glass panes, seed drawers, a tiny familiar nook, magical plant labels, and a locked cabinet clue.

patch_operations.instruction: Make the greenhouse feel cozier without hiding interactable props.
Clarify magical plant labels and drawer organization.
Make the locked cabinet clue visible from the reveal camera.

prompts.title: Cyberpunk Noodle Alley

patch_operations.instruction: Reduce neon clutter while keeping the alley cyberpunk.
Make the noodle cart the main focal point.
Make the back-room rumor door clearer without changing path width.

prompts.title: Ancient Moon Elevator

patch_operations.instruction: Clarify how the elevator mechanism works through visible parts.
Make the ascent destination easier to read from the reveal camera.
Improve safety gate visibility for game-readiness.

prompts.title: Horror Obby Lobby

patch_operations.instruction: Make the waiting area and start gate safer and more readable.

Reduce horror intensity while preserving the spooky theme.
